pricingFaq.headline: Pricing questions, answered
pricingFaq.q1: How does Search Guard pricing work?
pricingFaq.a1: We license Search Guard per production cluster — not per node. Scale your cluster to any size without your license cost changing. Development, staging, and QA systems are included free of charge.
pricingFaq.q2: What counts as a production cluster?
pricingFaq.a2: Any cluster serving live workloads. All non-production systems that support it — development, staging, testing, QA — are covered by the same license at no extra cost. Special setups like disaster-recovery clusters? Just ask — we'll find a sensible arrangement.
pricingFaq.q3: Is the Community Edition really free, even commercially?
pricingFaq.a3: Yes. The Community Edition is licensed under Apache 2.0 and free for any use, including commercial production, with no time limit and no node limit.
pricingFaq.q4: What happens when the trial ends?
pricingFaq.a4: Nothing disruptive — your cluster keeps running. To keep using Enterprise or Compliance features in production, simply obtain a license. Need more evaluation time? Trial extensions are usually no problem.
pricingFaq.q5: Do you offer academic or non-profit licenses?
pricingFaq.a5: Yes. Universities, research institutions, and non-profits can obtain the full feature set under special conditions — get in touch and tell us about your institution.
pricingFaq.q6: Can I embed Search Guard in my own product?
pricingFaq.a6: Yes. If you ship a product or managed service built on Elasticsearch, our OEM licenses let you embed and redistribute Search Guard. Contact us for details.
